name: Riohacha

queries.query: Riohacha Colombia official cadastral map parcel GIS catastro predial IGAC Alcaldía Riohacha
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Riohacha cartography page, IGAC open geospatial-data catalogue, IGAC ArcGIS REST services, and the current Riohacha 1:2,000 base-cartography MapServer. The Riohacha service exposes base-map layers such as buildings, roads, drainage, fences and contours, not a cadastral parcel layer. IGAC describes national cadastral datasets as official cadastral sources, but this bounded check did not obtain a safe parcel feature response.

queries.query: Riohacha Colombia mapa catastral predios oficial catastro geográfico
queries.result: La búsqueda en español localizó la página oficial de Cartografía Básica de la Alcaldía de Riohacha, los servicios cartográficos del IGAC y referencias oficiales a la gestión catastral del distrito. La cartografía pública de Riohacha identificada es cartografía básica 1:2.000 y no expone una capa parcelaria verificable en el servicio inspeccionado; no se obtuvo geometría parcelaria anónima con identidad nativa segura.

administrativeIdentity.identityEvidence: The first-party IGAC MapServer is titled carto2000riohacha44001000 and describes the 1:2,000 cartography of the urban head of Riohacha; the Alcaldía page identifies itself as the District of Riohacha. This is administrative/service identity, not parcel-hit evidence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Colombian cadastral/cartographic ecosystem: IGAC national cadastral open-data catalogue and ArcGIS REST services, with official Riohacha district cartography.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The current public Riohacha MapServer metadata was inspected. It is a 2025 publication of 1:2,000 base cartography produced from 2024 aerial photography and lists non-parcel layers including Construccion_P, geographic names, roads, fences, drainage, contours and related base features. The IGAC TableroCeM service was also inspected at service level and exposes municipality/service catalogue layers. Direct anonymous REST retrieval attempts for the service metadata/query endpoints timed out from this worker.
coverageAssessment.exactPointHitInterpretation: No exact-point parcel query was qualified. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted. The absence of a returned parcel response is a bounded service/worker outcome and is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

technicalBlocker: The public Riohacha service inspected is base cartography rather than a parcel feature layer. Anonymous direct REST requests to IGAC service endpoints timed out after 20-30 seconds from this worker; no login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe owner/address/titleholder/tax fields were used.
